record.paper_title: FPT Suspects and Tough Customers: Open Problems of Downey and Fellows
record.original_question: Given a basis X = {x1, x2, ..., xn} ⊂ Z^n for a lattice L and a positive integer k, is there a nonzero lattice vector x in L whose Euclidean norm ||x||_2 is at most k?

evidence.quote:
Shortest Vector Open
Instance: Ab a s i sX = {x1,x 2,...,x n}⊂ Zn for a latticeL
Parameter: A positive integerk
Question: Is there a non-zero vectorx ∈L, such that∥x∥2 ≤k?

artifact.self_contained_problem: Consider the following parameterized decision problem. An instance consists of a basis $X = \{x_1, x_2, \dots, x_n\} \subset \mathbb{Z}^n$ of a full-rank integer lattice $L = \{\sum_{i=1}^n a_i x_i : a_i \in \mathbb{Z}\}$ together with a positive integer $k$, where $k$ is taken as the parameter. The question is whether there exists a nonzero lattice vector $x \in L \setminus \{0\}$ such that the Euclidean norm satisfies $\|x\|_2 \le k$. Determine the parameterized complexity of this problem: is it fixed-parameter tractable (i.e., solvable in time $f(k)\cdot \mathrm{poly}(n)$ for some computable function $f$), or is it hard for some level of the W-hierarchy?
artifact.status_search_result: The exact parameterized status (FPT vs W[1]-hard) of the Shortest Vector Problem in the ℓ₂ norm with parameter k remains open. Significant progress has been achieved: Bhattacharyya, Bonnet, Egri, Ghoshal, Karthik C. S., Lin, Manurangsi, and Marx (ICALP 2018, JACM 2021) proved that SVP in any ℓ_p norm for p>1 has no FPT algorithm under Gap-ETH, and subsequent work (STOC 2023) established parameterized inapproximability for SVP in all ℓ_p norms. However, an exact W[1]-hardness or FPT classification under standard assumptions (W[1]≠FPT) is not fully settled.

status_evidence.title: Parameterized Intractability of Even Set and Shortest Vector Problem
status_evidence.snippet: Resolves intractability of parameterized SVP under Gap-ETH for ℓ_p norms with p>1.
status_evidence.claim: Recent work proves parameterized hardness of SVP under Gap-ETH, but exact W[1]-classification under W[1]≠FPT remains open.

status_evidence.title: Parameterized Inapproximability of the Minimum Distance Problem and SVP in all ℓ_p Norms
status_evidence.snippet: Establishes parameterized inapproximability of SVP in all ℓ_p norms (STOC 2023).
status_evidence.claim: Hardness of approximation in FPT time has been established for all ℓ_p norms.

status_evidence.title: Open Problems - Parameterized Complexity Wikidot
status_evidence.snippet: Community list of open problems in parameterized complexity.
status_evidence.claim: SVP parameterized by the norm bound k is among the well-known open problems of Downey–Fellows.
